question_en: In Colgate-Palmolive's fiscal 2023 10-K, how does the board oversee cybersecurity risk and who reports to it on the subject?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2023 của Colgate-Palmolive, hội đồng quản trị giám sát rủi ro an ninh mạng như thế nào và ai báo cáo cho họ về vấn đề này?
reference_answer: In fiscal 2023, Colgate-Palmolive's Board delegates specific responsibility for cybersecurity oversight to the Audit Committee, which also oversees the ERM process and risks tied to cybersecurity. The CISO reports to the Audit Committee on cybersecurity quarterly, or more often if needed, and outside experts periodically present to the Board.
evidence_quotes: Specific responsibility for cybersecurity oversight is delegated to the Audit Committee.

Our CISO provides a report to the Audit Committee on cybersecurity quarterly, or more frequently if circumstances warrant, including relevant cybersecurity incidents impacting the Company and on topics related to information security, data privacy and cyber risks and mitigation strategies.
In addition, outside experts periodically present to the Board on cybersecurity.

question_en: Which of APA, EOG, EQT and Williams bring up proved oil and gas reserves in the MD&A of their fiscal 2024 10-Ks?
question_vi: Trong phần MD&A của báo cáo 10-K năm tài chính 2024, những công ty nào trong số APA, EOG, EQT và Williams có nhắc đến trữ lượng dầu khí đã được chứng minh?
reference_answer: APA, EOG and EQT do: APA says commodity prices affect estimated proved reserves, EOG says its proved reserves estimates are subject to significant assumptions and frequently revised, and EQT says its proved reserve estimates are reassessed annually. Williams does not; its MD&A passage covers the Alabama Georgia Connector pipeline project instead.
evidence_quotes: Changes in commodity prices also impact estimated quantities of proved reserves.

EOG's proved reserves estimates, including the timing of future production, are also subject to significant assumptions and judgment, and are frequently revised (upwards and downwards) as more information becomes available.
Our estimates of proved reserves are reassessed annually using geological, reservoir and production performance data.

question_en: In its November 2024 8-K about a new debt offering, what did Martin Marietta say it did and will do with the net proceeds of the notes?

reference_answer: Martin Marietta used a portion of the net proceeds to repay all borrowings outstanding under its revolving credit facility and trade receivables securitization facility. The rest will go to general corporate purposes, which may include financing potential acquisitions, land purchases and other capital needs.
evidence_quotes: A portion of the net proceeds of the Notes were used for the repayment of all borrowings outstanding under Martin Marietta’s revolving credit facility and trade receivables securitization facility.
The remaining net proceeds of the Notes will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include financing potential acquisitions, land purchases and other capital needs.

question_en: In APA's Q1 2026 10-Q, how does the company handle its British pound exposure, and what would a 10% swing in the pound mean for it?
question_vi: Trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 1 năm 2026 của APA, công ty xử lý rủi ro tỷ giá đồng bảng Anh như thế nào, và nếu đồng bảng biến động 10% thì tác động ra sao?
reference_answer: APA's North Sea production is sold in U.S. dollars while most costs are paid in British pounds, and as of March 31, 2026 it had foreign exchange contracts with a total notional amount of £108 million to reduce its pound exposure. A 10 percent strengthening of the pound would produce a net gain of $6 million, while a 10 percent weakening would produce a loss of $14 million.
evidence_quotes: The Company’s North Sea production is sold under U.S. dollar contracts, while the majority of costs incurred are paid in British pounds.

As of March 31, 2026, the Company had outstanding foreign exchange contracts with a total notional amount of £108 million that are used to reduce its exposure to fluctuating foreign exchange rates for the British Pound.

A 10 percent strengthening of the British pound against the U.S. dollar would result in a foreign currency net gain of $6 million, while a 10 percent weakening of the British pound against the U.S. dollar would result in a loss of $14 million.

question_en: Which of Disney, Meta, Charter and Fox mention AI in the Business section of their fiscal 2025 10-Ks?

reference_answer: Meta, Charter and Fox do: Meta says it is innovating in AI across its products, Charter notes the Colorado Artificial Intelligence Act taking effect June 30, 2026, and Fox cites state legislation on disclosing AI use in political advertising. Disney does not; its passage covers FCC regulation without mentioning AI.
evidence_quotes: We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone.
Colorado passed the Colorado Artificial Intelligence Act (“CAIA”) which will take effect on June 30, 2026.
Additionally, a number of states have recently introduced or passed legislation as it relates to disclosures of the use of artificial intelligence (“AI”) in political advertising.

question_en: What is the Bell Semic patent dispute described in Synopsys's fiscal Q1 2023 10-Q, and how is Synopsys itself involved?
question_vi: Vụ tranh chấp bằng sáng chế Bell Semic trong báo cáo 10-Q quý 1 năm tài chính 2023 của Synopsys là gì, và bản thân Synopsys liên quan đến vụ này như thế nào?
reference_answer: Bell Semic, a patent monetization entity, began filing patent infringement suits on April 27, 2022 and ITC complaints on April 29, 2022 against tech companies over chips designed with EDA tools from vendors including Synopsys. Synopsys is not named as a respondent or defendant, but some named customers have sought defense and indemnity and Synopsys is defending some of them; in November and December 2022 it and other EDA vendors filed declaratory judgment actions and preliminary injunction motions.
evidence_quotes: On April 27, 2022, Bell Semiconductor LLC (Bell Semic), a patent monetization entity, began filing a series of patent infringement lawsuits against certain technology companies
On April 29, 2022, Bell Semic also began filing a series of complaints with the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC)

Synopsys is not named as a respondent or defendant in any of the aforementioned actions; however, certain of the respondents and defendants are Synopsys customers and have sought defense and indemnity from Synopsys under their End User License Agreements in response to Bell Semic’s allegations.

In November and December 2022, Synopsys and other EDA vendors filed actions for Declaratory Judgment of invalidity and/or non-infringement as to each of the six patents asserted by Bell Semic in the aforementioned actions.
